source_points.meaning: dense K+V element payload or explicit padded page
KV tensor backing is allocated from full configured pool sizes at initialization

allocation.interpretation: Payload represented by retained full published GPU blocks, derived from exact model geometry and selected-epoch dtype/backend/pool configuration. The pool is preallocated. This is not incremental GPU allocation, nvidia-smi growth, partial blocks, metadata or allocator overhead.
limits: Saved records do not dump live tensor storage nbytes, CUDA allocation addresses, allocator padding, or allocator-reserved totals; exact physical allocator bytes are unmeasured.
Pinned source files are from the recorded vLLM revision; this check does not independently hash the installed GPU files against those sources.
Warming occupies slots in an already allocated pool; occupied payload bytes are not incremental nvidia-smi memory or bytes newly malloced for that request.
Published full cache blocks omit active partial blocks, request block tables, metadata, graphs and other GPU memory. Block pool capacity may include reserved/null slots.
An event publication can repeat a prior logical block. Deduplicate by valid ancestry and process epoch, and account for removal/reset; event count alone is not physical occupancy.

previous_failed_attempt.explanation: The measurement identity sidecar returned HTTP 503 after the backend launcher was reparented to PID 1. The before-request observation failed before model dispatch. Dynamo did not return a model-request 503.
previous_failed_attempt.scope: Generated-tool smokes and reset/canary requests occurred. No replay model request was sent and no measured replay trial completed. This epoch is excluded from the successful 18-cell study.
